text:
maya: Ok team — planning thread for the Catalyst webinar + benchmark narrative. Need a concise hook, routing rules for inbound leads, and a short battlecard set we can hand to SDRs. ideas? :sparkles:

tom: Love the name. Hook idea: 'Same models, different serving economics.' quick stat from latest perf bench (p50 latency down 30% vs generic endpoints).

lucas: can we make that claim tight: source = internal perf lab, model family = LlamaX-16B, 512 tokens, avgs across 3 regions. short parenthetical: (lab, Q1 bench).

sarah: For SDRs we should give 3 common objection scripts: cost, reliability, compliance. super short bullets + one rebuttal line each.

kevin: Routing: inbound form -> lead-sieve -> if ARR>50k OR security tag=enterprise send to AE queue; else MQL to SDR nurture. Proposed pseudo-rule: `if (company_size >= 200 OR security_req == 'VPC') route='sales_enterprise' else route='sdr_nurture'`.

maya: +1. Also add an auto-fallback: if request mentions 'latency' or 'throughput' tag to eng-ops for a rapid bench offer. ops-bot can create a todo.

ops-bot: created task #INF-4821 "Run rapid bench for inbound latency leads" assigned to @lucas due 3/10. :white_check_mark:

elaine: Marketing deliverables: 1) webinar landing post (short), 2) 1-sheet benchmarking narrative (one pager), 3) battlecard with 6 soundbites and 3 objection handlers, 4) email nurture sequence for leads routed to SDRs.

lucas: For the benchmark one-pager: include micro-architecture callouts (KV cache, batching, kernel selection) — those are our differentiators vs cloud infra and LLM APIs. Keep it non-nerdy for sales (1 sentence each).

maya: Draft of 3 short soundbites (for battlecard): "Predictable throughput, not heroic engineering"; "Cut token cost with smart batching + cache"; "Unified runtime across hosted, dedicated, private". feedback?

kevin: tighten second: "Lower per-token costs via automatic batching & KV-prefix caching." Concrete > fuzzy.

sarah: Objection handlers: cost: "We measure token unit economics and can model your workload — typical savings 20-40% vs default endpoints." reliability: "Canary + fallback to smaller model variants keeps UX intact." compliance: "Private deployment + KMS/HSM option with audit logs." short & shareable.

maya: Nice. Need a 1-line webinar descriptor for the signup CTA: "How to cut inference cost and hit latency SLOs — real benchmarks, real routing patterns."

essst: elaine: I'll draft landing copy and 3-email nurture. can someone drop sample bench numbers we can quote? need ranges and methodology note.

lucas: I'll paste numbers in the doc later today — 512 token median numbers for LlamaX-16B vs managed endpoint baseline across us-west/us-east/eu-west.

maya: Final ask: by EOD tomorrow we want: webinar deck draft, benchmark one-pager, battlecard v0, routing rules snippet for growth. who owns what?

elaine: marketing + me for deck + landing. sarah for battlecard. kevin for routing snippet + handoff to sales ops. lucas for bench numbers. tom to QA messaging. maya to review and approve.

maya: Perfect. I'll run a 30m sync after drafts land. thanks all. :rocket:
